module.Title: Calculate an Average
module.Teaching: Arithmetic operators let Python combine sensor readings. Parentheses make the intended order easy to see.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which operator calculates the average after adding two readings?
module.PredictionExplanation: Dividing the total by 2 gives the average of two values.
module.DebugPrompt: Without parentheses, division happens before addition.
module.RecallPrompt: Write the average_temperature calculation from memory. Use these exact identifiers: zone_a, zone_b. Use the exact value 2.
module.TransferPrompt: Calculate total_runtime by adding pump_hours and fan_hours.
module.PreviewMessage: The facility dashboard can now calculate combined readings.
